hash.scope: entire pack object with the pack_hash key removed

convergence.se_scope: donksolver log.jsonl last chunk: root EV and SE estimated on that chunk's deals only (Solver.solve resets the EV accumulator each chunk); Monte Carlo estimate, not an exploitability bound

provenance.action_label_note: label = kind (tree.hpp ActKind) + ADDITIONAL chips at this node; blinds 100/200, stacks 8000 chips

ranges.detail: donksolver deals hole cards to every seat from the deck; no range input
